I keep telling you to fix your resume, so I ran my own through NextRaise's ATS checker. Six years of backend experience, with PayPal on it.

Score: 57 out of 100.

Reading it again like a stranger would, here is what I see:
- My bullets are small paragraphs. Most run 2 to 3 lines.
- Only 2 of my 18 bullets have a number in them.
- 4 bullets end with "received appreciation from leadership". It says nothing about what I actually built.
- 50+ skills in one block, with no sign of which ones matter.

Same traps as yours, just with a bigger company name. A strong career does not score well if the page does not show it.

I am fixing these and will share the new score.

Run yours and reply with your number. I will tell you the first thing I would fix:
